rv.q: 'In Old Age' is a beautifully essayed two-hander about elders who find not only companionship, but the courage to again fully embrace life as they once had.
Most of all, Marshall-Oliver and Bell are pitch perfect as Abasiama and Azell; they bring an authenticity that hooks us emotionally and artistically.

Dawn M. Simmons provides masterful direction to bring to life In Old Age , Mfoniso Udofia 's cleverly written portrayal of the balancing act between the physical and spiritual that can be affected by such a renovation.
What follows is an enchanting, and often hilarious pas de deux.
In Old Age avoids unnecessary trauma, is a GD delight.
Marshall-Oliver as Abasiama Bassey and Bell as Azell Abernathy are quite a captivating pair to watch through their heated and humorous exchanges and candor and the way they observe each other.
Finally, Abasiama will get to be her full self.
